notes.title: Free prologue with new boss and secret mission!
notes.content:
Greetings!

We are excited to present the new and mysterious free game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960560/Union_of_Gnomes_Prologue/]Union of Gnomes: Prologue[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960560/Union_of_Gnomes_Prologue/

It combines the creepy atmosphere of dark fantasy, cheerful humor, and, of course, the daring gnomes desperately fighting for their freedom and independence. 
 
[previewyoutube=atZ26XQlAEQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Lead a motley crew of guerrillas to free your captured comrades and escape the tyranny of the ruthless Snow White. For the tenacious players, we've hidden a secret quest within the prologue—conquering it will bring you closer to solving the mystery of the eighth gnome! Look for the clue in the video!

Here's what you'll find in the game:
[list]
[*] One new, unique and terribly dangerous mission!
[*] A dangerous new boss!
[*] A secret quest!
[*] A lot of well-known – and not so well-known – fairy tale characters who fight on the side of evil, trying to suppress and destroy the gnomes!
[*] Create unusual combos with your gnome cards to reach the end of the prologue or die with honor!
[/list]
Once you've finished the prologue (and added [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/]Union of Gnomes[/url] to your Steam Wishlist), you can look forward to the full story of the gnomes' heroic adventures as they fight for their freedom in the full game. The gnomes stand for freedom and the right not to impose subjugation on anyone else!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/ 

Don't forget to recommend the game to your friends and favorite streamers, share your impressions, and leave a review. 

Freedom to Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: Episode 5 is out! Enjoy the story finale!
notes.content:
The day we have all been waiting for has finally come! 

Episode 5 (season finale) is out today! The journey that took 1,5 years since Episode 1 released (30 years of in-game time for Odysseus - the game’s main character!) will finally be completed.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iL8vMF9fCms

Episode 5 brings answers to all of your questions, as well as cool new stuff:

[list]
[*] teaming up with your crew and unexpected discoveries that will follow
[*] time travel and changing heroes’ fates
[*] Barton’s secrets uncovered - what’s the mystery behind San Francisco’s most charismatic robot?
[*] play as Ada as the story comes to a gripping conclusion
[*] aaaaaaand a mysterious Artifact
[/list]

Now you can buy the whole season (including Episode 5) at a discount ([b]35%[/b]) right here:

If you’ve already bought the game, all you have to do is update it on Steam and voila! The whole season is at your disposal! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/645820/Odysseus_Kosmos_and_his_Robot_Quest_Complete_Season/

On behalf of the game’s creator Pavel Kostin, the artist Roman Gecerov and the publishing team at HeroCraft, we would like to thank you for your attention and for supporting lovingly crafted indie games! 

And now, its time to fasten your seat belts because this ship is heading for the stars!

notes.title: Quiz Results
notes.content:
Hello, dear friends! Let’s all say ‘hi’ to the winner of our previous contest: MasterDarkness33 was able to be the first one to complete Episode 4. As we’ve initially promised, he was actually added as a crew member inside the game:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30616450/13d4803be3e60d7aa410c62a5a96b72f4cbda47a.png[/img]

And, finally, let’s all congratulate the winners of our we-are-waiting-for-the-episode-5 quiz! Thank you for taking part in this contest -- we were really surprised with the amount of activity you demonstrated, and the overall atmosphere that was present in the comments section. We are so lucky to have you as our community =)       

So, without further adieu, here goes the list of the winners:

[list]
[*] 0.Jirkis  - 4 (14)
[*] 1.euka - 1 (4)
[*] 2.N.G - 1 (4)
[*] 3. BlackDraft  - 0 (4) (This means you have never been first, but twice ranked second by 2 points)
[/list]

The first three(1-3) participants from the list can pick one Steam game published by HeroCraft as their reward, while [b]Jirkis [/b]can pick not one but three games at once for being so active throughout the whole contest!

If you didn’t get into the list -- don’t be sad. We love you too and wish you luck in our further contests =) 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30616450/6895cd1dca507ebb680a19af467d07644834600d.png[/img]
